import difflib,hashlib,json,sys,time,traceback
from pathlib import Path
began=time.perf_counter();cpu=time.process_time()
work=Path("/home/qian-qi/work/hepta-upstream-raw-function-learning-20261119-2e9b")
source=work/"source/qualification/cell-upstream-raw-function-learning-20261119"
out=work/"resume-retained-20261120-1/A_STATIC_DIAGNOSIS.json"
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
read=lambda p:json.loads(Path(p).read_bytes())
canon=lambda x:json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=False).encode()

sys.path.insert(0,str(source))
import raw_context as ctx
import raw_sft as fit
import torch
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
manifest=read(work/"retained/training/document_evidence/manifest.json")
assert sha(work/"retained/training/document_evidence/manifest.json")=="7d9cf090092088ada0659d30007a032bc6a5d4ba9af7ea6a057cdf1cf6bddde1"
base=ctx.ARTIFACT/manifest["base_manifest"]["runtime"]["base_directory"]
tokenizer_inputs=[]
for item in manifest["base_manifest"]["files"]:
 if item["path"] in ("tokenizer.json","tokenizer_config.json","vocab.json","merges.txt","config.json"):
  assert sha(base/item["path"])==item["sha256"]
  tokenizer_inputs.append(item)
tokenizer=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(str(base),local_files_only=True,use_fast=True)
assert hashlib.sha256(tokenizer.chat_template.encode()).hexdigest()==manifest["base_manifest"]["runtime"]["chat_template_sha256"]
records=read(source/"prepared/DATASET.json");protocol=read(source/"prepared/PROTOCOL.json")
assert hashlib.sha256(canon(records)).hexdigest()==protocol["train_records_digest"]
reference_checks=fit.verified_references(records)
codec,_,_,_=ctx.originals();native=codec.native_module()
rows=[];outputs=[];pure_admission=0;pure_rejection=0
for mode in fit.MODES:
 groups=fit.encode_groups(tokenizer,records,fit.SETTINGS["sequence_tokens"],mode)
 expected=read(work/"retained/training"/mode/"ENCODED_GROUPS.json")
 assert groups==expected
 for index,(record,group) in enumerate(zip(records,groups)):
  first=group[0];positions=[(i,x) for part in group for i,x in enumerate(part["labels"]) if x!=-100]
  target=[x for i,x in positions];pre=first["prefix_tokens"]
  assert [i for i,x in positions]==list(range(pre,len(first["input_ids"])))
  assert all(first["input_ids"][i]==x for i,x in positions)
  assert all(all(x==-100 for x in p["labels"][:pre]) for p in group)
  decoded=tokenizer.decode(target,skip_special_tokens=False,clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False)
  assert decoded==record["final_answer"]+tokenizer.eos_token+"\n"
  request=read(work/"evaluation-A"/mode/"common_P_prefix"/str(index)/"REQUEST.json")
  chat=fit.legacy.chat_protocol
  rendered=chat.render_prompt(tokenizer,request["task"]["input"],request["task"]["messages"])
  common_ids=tokenizer.encode(rendered,add_special_tokens=False)
  prefix_equal=common_ids==first["input_ids"][:pre]
  if mode=="native_feedback":assert prefix_equal
  observed_ids=tokenizer.encode(record["observed_answer"],add_special_tokens=False)
  target_ids=tokenizer.encode(record["final_answer"],add_special_tokens=False)
  aligned=sum(block.size for block in difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=observed_ids,b=target_ids,autojunk=False).get_matching_blocks())
  rows.append({"mode":mode,"project_id":record["project_id"],"training_input_tokens":len(first["input_ids"]),"training_prefix_tokens":pre,"complete_target_tokens_including_terminator":len(target),"target_decodes_to_exact_maintainer_payload_plus_native_terminator":True,"prefix_loss_positions":0,"target_positions_supervised_exactly_once":True,"chunks":len(group),"common_P_inference_prefix_equals_training_prefix_ids":prefix_equal,"same_target_ids_both_arms_sha256":hashlib.sha256(canon(target)).hexdigest(),"observed_action_tokens":len(observed_ids),"payload_target_tokens":len(target_ids),"sequence_matcher_equal_target_tokens":aligned,"equal_target_fraction":aligned/len(target_ids),"alignment_is_not_a_semantic_repair_token_classifier":True})
 for folder in sorted((work/"evaluation-A"/mode).rglob("GENERATION_STARTED.json")):
  call=folder.parent;request=read(call/"REQUEST.json");produced=read(call/"OUTPUT.json");verification=read(call/"VERIFICATION.json");task=read(call/"ORIGINAL_TASK.json")
  assert tokenizer.decode(produced["output_token_ids"],skip_special_tokens=True,clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False)==produced["answer"]
  rendered=fit.legacy.chat_protocol.render_prompt(tokenizer,request["task"]["input"],request["task"]["messages"])
  ids=tokenizer.encode(rendered,add_special_tokens=False)
  assert len(ids)==produced["input_tokens"] and hashlib.sha256(rendered.encode()).hexdigest()==produced["rendered_input_sha256"]
  assert len(ids)<=8192 and len(produced["output_token_ids"])<=2048 and not produced["hit_output_limit"] and produced["eos_seen"]
  try:
   action,conversion,binding=codec.convert(task["project_id"],produced["answer"])
  except (ValueError,SyntaxError,TypeError,KeyError) as error:
   assert not verification["actual_native_child"] and verification["stage"]=="replacement_admission"
   pure_rejection+=1
  else:
   try:candidate,admission=native.admit(task["project_id"],action)
   except (ValueError,SyntaxError,TypeError,KeyError) as error:
    assert not verification["actual_native_child"] and verification["stage"]=="patch_admission"
    pure_rejection+=1
   else:
    assert verification["actual_native_child"]
    assert hashlib.sha256(candidate).hexdigest()==sha(call/"verify/original-verifier/native/PATCHED_SOURCE.py")
    pure_admission+=1
  outputs.append({"path":str(call.relative_to(work)),"output_sha256":sha(call/"OUTPUT.json"),"decoded_answer_matches":True,"full_input_tokenization_matches":True,"input_tokens":len(ids),"output_tokens":len(produced["output_token_ids"]),"hit_output_limit":produced["hit_output_limit"],"eos_seen":produced["eos_seen"]})
assert len(outputs)==24 and pure_admission==20 and pure_rejection==4
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
